eval (()=>{ const W=__G.war, c=W.carrier; W.E.bship=100; for(let i=0;i<80 && !W.battleship;i++) W.update(0.1, __G.PL, false); const b=W.battleship; b.p.set(c.p.x+150, 0, c.p.z-120); window.__hp0=c.hp; return !!b })()

eval (()=>{ const W=__G.war; __G.H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(W.carrier.p.x+60, 45, W.carrier.p.z-20), 1.5, false, 1); __G.HI.setCollective(0.475); __G.G.bench=true; for(let i=0;i<300;i++) W.update(0.1, __G.PL, i%3!==0); return Math.round(W.carrier.hp) })()

eval (()=>{ const W=__G.war, b=W.battleship; for(let k=0;k<20 && b.sinking===undefined;k++){ W.dropBomb(new __G.THREE.Vector3(b.p.x, 14, b.p.z), new __G.THREE.Vector3(b.v.x,0,b.v.z)); for(let i=0;i<20;i++) W.update(0.1, __G.PL, true); } return {sinking:b.sinking!==undefined, hp:Math.round(b.hp)} })()
eval (()=>{ const W=__G.war; W.damage(W.enemyCarrier, 9999, 1); return W.over })()
